subject.title: fix(feishu): accumulate streamed final delta chunks (#91562)

question: Should maintainers accept a proof override after repairing/rebasing this Feishu final-chunk fix, or require live Feishu/CardKit proof before merge?
rationale: The external contributor says they cannot access a live Feishu tenant, while ClawSweeper cannot mark helper console output and mocked tests as sufficient proof for a user-visible Feishu CardKit change.

options.title: Require Repair Plus Proof
options.body: Tighten the helper, rebase onto current main, and require either redacted live Feishu/CardKit evidence or a maintainer-run proof override before merge.

options.title: Override After Maintainer Verification
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly own the proof gap if they verify the Feishu path through a sanctioned tenant or accept the channel risk.

options.title: Fold Into Broader Feishu Streaming Work
options.body: Pause or close this branch if maintainers want the latest-token case handled together with the broader Feishu streaming-card reliability tracker.

recommendation.title: Require Repair Plus Proof
recommendation.body: Tighten the helper, rebase onto current main, and require either redacted live Feishu/CardKit evidence or a maintainer-run proof override before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the live assignee and have recent Feishu streaming-card-area history, making them the best current owner for proof override or branch disposition.
